class.name: FoxShopMenu
class.brief_description: A UI controller that populates and manages a list of shop items.
class.description: Handles the instantiation of UI slots and routes purchase requests.

method.name: populate
method.description: Clears the container and populates it with items from the given [param catalog].

method.name: add_item
method.description: Instantiates a new slot for the given [param item] and connects its signals.

method.name: update_affordability
method.description: Forces all child slots to recalculate affordability.

members.member: The [PackedScene] to instantiate for each item.
The parent [Control] node where instantiated slots are added.
The active wallet used to evaluate affordability.

signal.name: item_purchased
signal.description: Emitted when an item is successfully purchased.

signal.name: purchase_denied
signal.description: Emitted when a purchase is attempted but fails.

signal.name: item_focused
signal.description: Emitted when a specific item's slot gains UI focus.

signal.name: item_unfocused
signal.description: Emitted when a specific item's slot loses UI focus.

signal.name: catalog_populated
signal.description: Emitted after the menu finishes instantiating the new catalog.
